notes: Baseline: the untuned model scores 58.2% on all 3,714 test items; the per-family numbers are in `families`.

Earlier strides, by hand: on ten hard families, training on checked short answers gave +4.8 and +7.9 points (two seeds), while the same amount of unchecked answers gave -3.9. No gain carried to families that were not trained.
Two children trained on identical data differed by about 3 points, so a difference under about 5 points needs a second seed before it means anything.
Practice items 0 to 71 of those ten families are already used; start pool_offset at 72 there for fresh items.
